_comment: MU Linux 0.97k Pterodactyl egg. Import in a PTDL_v2 Panel.
name: MU Linux 0.97k Server
author: support@mu-linux.com
description: MU Online 0.97k services. The installer downloads the selected release into the server volume; the runtime image contains only dependencies and the Pterodactyl entrypoint.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
ARCH=$(uname -m)
case "${ARCH}" in
  x86_64) ASSET_ARCH=amd64 ;;
  aarch64|arm64) ASSET_ARCH=arm64 ;;
  *) echo "Unsupported architecture: ${ARCH}" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
REPOSITORY=EmanuelCatania/Mu-Linux
ASSET=mu-linux-97k-server-${ASSET_ARCH}.tar.gz
URL=https://github.com/${REPOSITORY}/releases/download/${MU_RELEASE_TAG}/${ASSET}
mkdir -p /mnt/server
echo "Downloading ${ASSET} from ${MU_RELEASE_TAG}..."
curl --fail --location --retry 3 "${URL}" -o /tmp/mu-server.tar.gz
tar -xzf /tmp/mu-server.tar.gz -C /mnt/server
rm /tmp/mu-server.tar.gz
chmod +x /mnt/server/start.sh /mnt/server/ConnectServer/ConnectServer /mnt/server/JoinServer/JoinServer /mnt/server/DataServer/DataServer /mnt/server/GameServer/GameServer
echo "MU Linux 0.97k server installed."

variables.name: Release tag
variables.description: GitHub release to install. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Database host
variables.description: MySQL hostname or IP address.

variables.name: Database port
variables.description: MySQL port.

variables.name: Database user
variables.description: MySQL user.

variables.name: Database password
variables.description: MySQL password.

variables.name: Database name
variables.description: MySQL database name.

variables.name: Public server address
variables.description: Public IPv4 address or hostname advertised to MU clients.

variables.name: Packet trace
variables.description: 1 = the GameServer exposes its packet trace (read it with ./mu-trace tail). Nothing is copied while no reader is attached.

variables.name: Record packet trace
variables.description: 1 = also record the trace to GameServer/LOG/trace (needs Packet trace = 1).

variables.name: Packet trace size (MB)
variables.description: Maximum size of the recorded trace; the oldest files are deleted first.

variables.name: Launcher patches
variables.description: 1 = publish the operator patches from Data/Patches for the launcher (mu-patch). See docs/parches-del-launcher.md.

variables.name: Patch channel
variables.description: Your patch channel, owner/name in lowercase (e.g. myserver/overlay). Must match the one compiled in your launcher.

variables.name: Patch check interval
variables.description: Seconds between checks for new patch folders.

variables.name: Patch URL
variables.description: Public URL of /updates/ on your web (several separated by commas). Empty: the one compiled in the launcher.

variables.name: Launcher ConnectServers
variables.description: ConnectServer addresses for the launcher, host:port separated by commas. Empty: PUBLIC_IP:44405.

variables.name: Launcher news
variables.description: Text the launcher shows over its image. \n breaks the line.

variables.name: Website URL
variables.description: Your server website (https://...). The launcher shows it and opens it from Options.

variables.name: Base source
variables.description: Client base for the launcher if you use your own fork (empty: the one compiled in the launcher).

variables.name: Base tag
variables.description: Release tag of that base (empty: the compiled one).

variables.name: Base key
variables.description: Public key that signs that base, 64 hex digits (empty: the compiled one).

variables.name: Require launcher
variables.description: 1 = the desktop client opened without the launcher opens the launcher and closes (so nobody plays outdated; not a security measure). The web client ignores it.

variables.name: MU-Guard
variables.description: 1 = start mu-guard, the client protection (docs/mu-guard.md). It needs its own TCP port: MU-Guard port.

variables.name: Require MU-Guard
variables.description: 1 = reject the login of a desktop client that was not opened by its guardian.

variables.name: MU-Guard port
variables.description: TCP port of mu-guard (an additional allocation). The client gets it from the ConnectServer.
